closing_statement: This dossier records, at most, an unexplained observation: a surface feature that the checks listed above did not account for. It makes no claim about what caused the feature or where it came from. An unexplained observation is not evidence of any particular origin: checks that were not run, gaps in the data and errors in this pipeline all remain possible explanations.
